gloss: to smash, to crush, to break

definitions.gloss: to smash, to crush, to break into pieces
definitions.explanation: To break something hard into smaller fragments.

definitions.gloss: to simplify, to explain in simple terms
definitions.explanation: To make complex information easier to understand.

examples.japanese: {氷|こおり}を{砕|くだ}いてジュースに{入|い}れる。
examples.english: Crush ice and put it in the juice.

examples.japanese: {難|むずか}しい{内容|ないよう}を{砕|くだ}いて{説明|せつめい}する。
examples.english: Explain difficult content in simple terms.

examples.japanese: {岩|いわ}を{砕|くだ}いて{砂利|じゃり}を{作|つく}る。

notes:
{砕|くだ}く means to smash or crush hard objects into smaller pieces.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
- Pair: {砕|くだ}ける (intransitive - to be broken)
- Pattern: Xを{砕|くだ}く

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {氷|こおり}を{砕|くだ}く (to crush ice)
- {骨|ほね}を{砕|くだ}く (to work very hard, lit: to crush one's bones)
- {砕|くだ}いて{説明|せつめい}する (to explain in simple terms)
- {砕|くだ}けた{表現|ひょうげん} (casual expression)

RELATED VOCABULARY:
- {割|わ}る (to break, divide)
- {壊|こわ}す (to break, destroy)
